senses.gloss:
बिबोधयिषु बिबोधयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr.
Desid. of Caus. of rt. 1. बुध्), wishing to rouse, in-
tending to wake; [cf. बुबोधयिषु.]

बिब्बोक बिब्बोक, अस्, m. (also written विव्-
वोक, विब्बोक, q. q. v. v.), haughty indifference; (in
erotic poetry) affectation of indifference towards a
beloved object through pride and conceit.
